notes: Universal slot picks - a cross-class starting frame drawn from community gearing guides. Treat these as seed examples and verify each item's exact stats, source, faction availability, and current-meta status at authoring time.

shared.name: Green Tinted Goggles
shared.notes: De-facto BiS head for many specs; head has no enchant at this bracket, which is why Engineering goggles matter.

shared.name: Lucky Fishing Hat
shared.notes: Alternative head; harder to obtain than the goggles. Verify current stats.
